name: Supergas Power (2019) Ltd
summary: Operating within Israel, Supergas Power (2019) Ltd is engaged in the supply chain of various energy commodities, including liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), natural gas, electricity, and thermal energy. These products serve a broad spectrum of uses: fueling industrial burners and boilers, powering commercial ovens in bakeries and restaurants, providing heating for institutional and agricultural (poultry) settings, warming water, and serving as vehicle fuel. Furthermore, the company's energy solutions support residential cooking, heating, and cooling, and contribute to the operation of smaller power generation facilities. Founded in 1953 and based in Netanya, Israel, the company will transition to its current name, Supergas Power (2019) Ltd, in October 2025, having previously traded as Electra Power (2019) Ltd. It operates as a subsidiary of Elco Ltd.
